_comment: Pinned Chrome for Testing for the publish verify job. Set version (e.g. from Google's last-known-good-versions JSON); URLs derive as https://storage.googleapis.com/chrome-for-testing-public/<version>/<platform>/chrome-<platform>.zip. An empty sha256 makes a DRY RUN print 'CHROME_PIN <platform> <version> <sha256> <bytes>' and fail the step; copy the value here. A real publish refuses an empty sha256. Hosts: win64 (windows-2025), mac-arm64 (xcode-27) and linux64 (ubuntu-24.04, publish.yml verify-linux for units in ci/linux-required.json). linux64 is UNRECORDED (empty sha256): a real publish that needs Linux Chrome refuses until a dry run records it. "headlessShell" pins the chrome-headless-shell-<platform>.zip of the same version (URL .../<version>/<platform>/chrome-headless-shell-<platform>.zip), win64 only: the Windows rightkit-browser fixture runs it because chrome.exe unconditionally starts the crashpad handler, which cannot create its pipe inside an AppContainer.
